answer: Shards are assigned from the zenith graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The sparrow assignment is published and trellis records each panel. The grading quorum of 3 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an farming party cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 2512 identities would post 4311 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
